name: Twisted Cow Distillery

evidence.note: Official event: SqueezePlay at the tasting room, Sat Oct 3, 8-11 pm.
Tasting room page mentions comfortable seating, live music, tours and events.
Yelp review excerpt: staff pulled a long table over so a group could see the band on a Saturday night.

dancing.notes: The tasting room has table seating and bands on weekend nights. Reviews talk about finding a table to watch the band; we found no reports of dancing.

description: A craft distillery in East Northport with a farm-industrial tasting room serving cocktails made from its own spirits, plus tours, trivia and live music.
reviewNotes: Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Phone is published as 631-980-TCOW (= 631-980-8269). SqueezePlay confirmed for Oct 3; the second act Ira listed, 'CarTunes', was not found on the venue site (an acoustic act also appears that day).
